newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE average daily T-bond trade over 3,000 lots.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE average daily T-bond trade over 3,000 lots.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Friday it had traded an average daily volume of 3,121 lots in the T-bond future in the first week of its new link up with the CBOT.
It said the average volume in T-bond options was 295 and average volume in Bund futures on the Chicago Board of Trade was 8,797.
The new link enables traders to use open outcry to trade the Bund and T-bond futures on both CBOT and LIFFE.
"As far as we're concerned, we're very pleased with the first week of trade in both the T-bond and Bund contracts," a LIFFE spokesman said.
